transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. [Name]. I guess I'm here because... well, things at work are just getting really messy lately. I'm an electrician, and I just can't seem to keep my focus on one thing. Like, I'll be working on an estimate or filling out a code form, and then I hear a tool drop, or my phone buzzes with a text, or I just get this sudden new idea about reorganizing the workshop. And just like that, I'm completely off track. Because of that, jobs are starting to get mixed up, and I really need to get a handle on it.
Thinking back, have you noticed this kind of trouble staying focused and getting easily sidetracked since you were a kid, or is this something that's really only started recently?

No, it's definitely not something from when I was a kid. I was always pretty good at keeping my head down and getting the job done. This... whatever this is, it's really just started up recently. I'd say it's been building for about seven months now. That's right around the time we took on the new mortgage to buy the workshop and upgrade all the equipment. Ever since then, it's just been getting worse.
Besides the work distractions, have you noticed yourself worrying a lot about other things too—like your health, family, or finances in general—even when there's no clear reason to worry?

No, not really. I mean, I know I mentioned the mortgage, but I'm not actually sitting around worrying about the money or if we'll go under or anything like that. I feel pretty good about the business overall. I don't really worry about my health or my family either. It's just... I can't keep my mind on what I'm doing. It's not a nervous thing, it's just a focus thing.
Have you been using alcohol, marijuana, or any other recreational drugs or medications more than usual over these past seven months?

No, I haven't. I don't really do any drugs, and I just have a beer or two on the weekends sometimes. Nothing's changed with that, and I haven't started taking any new medications either. It's definitely not a substance thing.
Over these past seven months, have you noticed yourself feeling unusually upbeat, energetic, or needing much less sleep than normal, even when you weren't trying to push yourself?

Yeah, actually, the sleep part is definitely true. For months now, I've been sleeping maybe... three or four hours a night. But I don't feel tired at all. I'll pop up way before dawn, and I just feel completely ready to go, like I had a full night's rest. I'll just get right to work—pricing out materials, answering emails, or sketching out another system for a job. I just have all this energy as soon as I wake up.

During this time, have you noticed yourself feeling unusually confident or convinced you can do things others might see as risky or unrealistic—like taking on big new projects, spending large amounts of money, or feeling like you have special abilities or insight others don't?

Yeah, I have actually. I mean... I keep feeling like I can just take on these massive commercial jobs and train up a whole crew right now. It just feels like a sure thing to me. Even though, you know, part of me knows my licensing and my actual experience aren't really quite where they need to be for all that yet. But I just feel completely convinced I could handle it anyway.
Have you experienced anything like hearing voices or seeing things that others don't, or holding beliefs—like having special powers or a special mission—that others have told you aren't true?

No, nothing like that. I haven't heard any voices or seen anything that isn't there. And I don't think I have any kind of special powers or a mission or anything. It's really just the energy and feeling like I can take on all these big jobs. But no, no voices or anything like that.
